no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Commercial-stage company. Lead asset PEDMARK (sodium thiosulfate) FDA-approved (Sept 2022) and EMA-approved (June 2023) for prevention of ototoxicity associated with cisplatin chemotherapy in pediatric patients. No company-sponsored active P1/P2/P3 trials returned by ctgov sponsor search.

commercial_product.indication: Reduction of risk of cisplatin-induced ototoxicity in pediatric patients (1 month and older) with localized, non-metastatic solid tumors
